programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: In Riverside, Lisa dons her cowboy garb and brings her money sock along; Rene sinks his teeth into an unassuming unit; Brandi gets to go on a scavenger hunt; Ivy and his boys get a glimpse of retired life; Darrell just isn't feeling like himself.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: San Bernardino is full of surprises, particularly for Rene and Casey, who roll the dice on some sealed totes; Kenny stumbles over some odd-looking car parts; Lisa shields herself from disaster with an unusually expensive locker.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Ivy is on the warpath in Lancaster, doing his best to intimidate the other buyers, and he won't be losing any sleep over it; Brandi begrudgingly lets Bozek decide which locker they buy; Dusty goes up against the King to prove a point.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: Two for the Price of Dust
programs.desc: The big guns come out in Riverside, but Rene isn't having any of it; Darrell presses his luck with a smaller locker and makes a neat profit; Dusty finds that once he gets going, it's hard to stop... so he just keeps reloading.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: It's a Safe Time to Get Lit!
programs.desc: Lisa heads to Huntington Beach; Darrell spends the right amount of time going through his locker; Kenny rides a recent string of luck right into his unit, while Rene puts his bankroll up against a pair of safes.

programs.title: Parking Wars
programs.desc: Clerical errors create havoc for a frustrated man trying to reclaim his impounded vehicle, while Gina is bombarded with outrageous excuses from illegal South Street parkers; Rodney and Sonjia dampen holiday spirits on the coldest day of the year.
